question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation can be attained together.
A great accomplishment encompasses both enjoyment and liberation.
Such accomplishment produces favor with the yoginīs.
inference: One who attains the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: One who attains the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs.
